en: Fixed `/code-review <pr number>` sometimes reviewing the checked-out branch instead of the pull request without saying so: it now reads the pull request with `gh pr diff`, or says when it can't
zh: 修复了 `/code-review <pr number>` 有时在未说明的情况下审查已检出的分支而非 pull request 的问题：现在会通过 `gh pr diff` 读取 pull request，无法读取时会明确说明
